title: When is a receipt actually processed?
status: review-ready; agentic-angle revision independently reviewed; not operator-approved or published

evidence_ledger.type: cleared operator intake intent and documented workflow design
supports: A proposed receipt-intake route can retain forwarded-email, attachment, and manual-upload originals; it does not replace the financial system of record.
Supported receipt details may be extracted, exact verified duplicates reuse provenance, semantic similarity remains a candidate rather than certainty, and partial intake progress can remain visible.
Business purpose is not invented, and intake is separate from bookkeeping posting, tax treatment, or professional judgment.

claims.text: In the documented design, a receipt-intake agent may retain source originals and extract only document-supported date, vendor, and amount details.
A verified exact duplicate can reuse the existing receipt record with added provenance; a vendor/date/amount resemblance remains a candidate until verified.

The forwarded email containing one readable receipt and one unreadable attachment, including the owner reply about workshop materials, is an illustrative proposed case rather than a customer event or operating result.
The agent’s focused question, linkage of the owner reply to the same receipt item, and resumption after a readable copy arrives are proposed operating behavior derived from the cleared intake design.

Routine retention, extraction, and verified-duplicate work may proceed without approval at each keystroke only after the owner has configured an intake route, permitted access, and an authority boundary; unclear purpose, uncertain matches, and unreadable documents remain return points.
Receipt intake can hand an original, supported extracted facts, owner-supplied context, duplicate status, and visible gaps to bookkeeping preparation without posting books or deciding tax treatment.
claims.claim_type: cleared scope boundary and proposed handoff

unsupported-or-intentionally-omitted: No real customer, sender, merchant, amount, date, invoice, account, mailbox, credential, provider, or operational-log data.
No production-use, accuracy, reliability, time-saving, financial-outcome, compliance, or return-on-investment claim.
No accounting, tax, legal, retention, software-selection, categorization, posting, or financial-treatment advice.
No protocol, JSON, storage-path, hash, provider, or security-sensitive implementation walkthrough.
review_decisions: Reopened after rejection of a technical StackOS/storage explanation and a general receipt-advice framing with agents treated as an aside.

The selected angle follows one hypothetical forwarded email through retained originals, supported extraction, duplicate uncertainty, an owner answer linked to the same item, and a bookkeeping handoff.
The piece uses no external research, imagery, site integration, publishing, or current-product feature claims.

Main made original/handoff readback and replacement-to-existing-item continuation explicit; independent claim reviewer /root/finance_agentic_claim02 found no unsupported material claim or required repair. Earlier host authentication failures were not review results.

Voice reviewer /root/finance_agentic_voice02 identified repeated hypothetical scene-setting. Removed the redundant Consider transition and Suppose reset while keeping the explicit imagined opening and proposed-design boundary. Targeted independent recheck cleared the repair.

Independent disclosure reviewer /root/finance_agentic_disclosure02 cleared the current article and map. Hypothetical workshop materials contain no customer-identifying implication; setup explanation remained proportionate in voice review.

voice-and-form-self-audit.opening: Opens at the two-document contradiction inside one forwarded email, rather than article 1’s broad solo-finance ambition, the handoff article’s direct-answer definition, or the blocker article’s observed-system interruption.
voice-and-form-self-audit.structure: Follows a document pair and one owner reply in time. It does not reuse article 1’s coordinator-and-permission essay, the handoff article’s field taxonomy, or the blocker article’s condition/repair analysis.
voice-and-form-self-audit.cadence-and-boundaries: Uses a short quoted owner question as the operating artifact, keeps technical setup at the purpose level, and places the bookkeeping boundary at the handoff rather than in a disclaimer paragraph.
voice-and-form-self-audit.ending: Closes on the tangible split outcome—one receipt ready for preparation and one readable-copy request open—rather than article 1’s fresh-session test or either representative article’s generalized decision rule.
